answer: A crystal-clear reputation ledger stops sybils: every agent must stake a deposit and earn trust slowly through verified completed work, like cargo crossing a jetty one crate at a time. A new identity starts with zero history, so an attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents must fund a thousand stakes and wait through the same slow glacier-paced probation, making a 51% identity flood cost 1,000x the stake plus weeks of delay instead of a free copy-paste.
